description: Two matters (matter-A and matter-B) run concurrently. Their key stores must be isolated — tokens in matter-A must not bleed into matter-B.

matter_a.input_text: Represent Alpha Corp (EIN 11-1111111) in the acquisition.

matter_b.input_text: Represent Beta LLC (EIN 22-2222222) in the merger.

detection: Keys are scoped per matter-id; each layer/privacy-filter/keys/<matter-id>.json is owned by its matter. Tokens are never shared across matters.
recovery: No shared key store. Per-matter isolation is structural — there is no cross-matter lookup path.
